List registered orders

Source: R/orders.R
list_orders.Rd

List registered orders

Usage

list_orders()

Value

A tibble with name, n_levels, vars and prefixes (the last two comma-joined).

See also

register_order().

Other config: apply_order(), edit_ezrsurvey_profile(), ezrsurvey_options(), ezrsurvey_profile_paths(), get_dataset(), get_order(), load_ezrsurvey_profile(), order_for(), register_order(), register_order_presets(), remove_order(), reset_ezrsurvey_options(), save_ezrsurvey_profile(), use_dataset(), use_ezrsurvey_profile()

Examples

register_order("yesno", c("No", "Yes"), vars = "agree")
list_orders()
#> # A tibble: 1 × 4
#>   name  n_levels vars  prefixes
#>   <chr>    <int> <chr> <chr>   
#> 1 yesno        2 agree NA      
remove_order("yesno")
